entries.heading: ふう【×楓】
entries.verifiedClaim: The Japanese noun ふう names a separate tree, with the explicit supplement that かえで is a different kind. The kanji-item heading gives onフウ and distinguishes tree-name senses, including maple compounds.
entries.limits: No numeric frequency or current family-taxonomy claim is derived from the wrapper's differing older botanical classifications.

entries.heading: かえ‐で【楓・槭樹・鶏冠木】
entries.verifiedClaim: Sense1 identifies maple plants, autumn leaf coloring and garden cultivation. Other senses and historical spellings/readings are inspected but not taught as the ordinary plant sense. Separateふうheading explains that the tree differs from Japanese maple.
